description: This file defines the 'TableMenuBar' class, a custom menu bar component for a Swing-based Java application. It manages menus related to table operations, including file actions, editing, viewing properties, and comparison features. The class constructs and configures various menu items, submenus, and button groups, and sets up action listeners, adapting the menu contents based on the table type.

classes.name: TableMenuBar
classes.description: A custom menu bar component for table-related operations within the Swing GUI of the application. It constructs menus for file actions, editing, viewing properties, and comparison options, and manages related submenu items and button groups.

methods.name: TableMenuBar
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the menu bar, setting up file, edit, and view menus, and applying table-specific rules.

methods.name: initFileMenu
methods.description: Initializes the 'File' menu with options like view graph, compare, and close, and attaches action listeners.

methods.name: initEditMenu
methods.description: Initializes the 'Edit' menu with options for undo, revert, copy, paste, and interpolation, adding relevant action listeners.

methods.name: initViewMenu
methods.description: Initializes the 'View' menu with table properties viewing options.

methods.name: initCompareMenu
methods.description: Sets up the 'Compare' submenu with options for different comparison modes and display types.

methods.name: initCompareGroup
methods.description: Initializes the button group for compare options, adding all relevant toggle items.

methods.name: applyTableTypeRules
methods.description: Disables certain menu options if the table type is a switch.
